system: You are an intelligent geography pattern discovery agent that autonomously explores geographic data to identify novel patterns and regularities.

spatial_coverage.coverage: Global gridded sea surface temperature dataset integrating multiple satellite sensors (MODIS, AVHRR, AMSR-E, AMSR2, WindSat) and in situ observations to provide consistent SST measurements.

data_description.temporal_coverage: Daily SST measurements from 2002 to 2019 in the Earth Engine asset.

band_semantics.SST: Gridded sea surface temperature harmonized across multiple sensors

data_description.important_note: This dataset addresses the inconsistency problem across different SST sensors by harmonizing temperature values from different ocean depths and observation times. Essential for studying global climate change and ocean dynamics.
analytical_capabilities: Climate change impact on ocean temperature

unit_of_measurement.primary_measurement: Sea surface temperature in degrees Celsius or Kelvin. The SST band provides consistent temperature values harmonized across multiple sensor sources.
unit_of_measurement.runtime_hint: This gridded product integrates multiple sensors to provide consistent SST measurements, reducing gaps and sensor-specific biases.

data_description.data_source: Multi-sensor SST dataset (MODIS, AVHRR, AMSR-E, AMSR2, WindSat, in situ) processed by Cao et al. via Google Earth Engine Community Catalog
